name: greminder
description: Chrome extension that shows a Google Meet-styled banner when 5 minutes remain in a scheduled call.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.store:zip: npm run build && rm -f store/greminder-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist && zip -qr -X ../store/greminder-$npm_package_version.zip .
